rationale: Identity was correctly verified via name + zip. However, several policy requirements were not met: (1) The agent executed an exchange without first explicitly restating the exact change and obtaining the user’s confirmation to proceed. The user selected an option, but the agent did not present a confirmation step summarizing item IDs, refund method/amount, and shipping/return details before performing the write. (2) The agent used an item ID (2757705742) for the original IPX7 earbud without demonstrating that this item exists in the order; the visible order line in #W3470184 shows an IPX4 earbud (item_id 6452271382), and the rest is truncated, so the assertion is unsupported. (3) The agent used the “delivered order items” exchange tool without confirming the order’s status. (4) The agent stated a specific refund amount ($15.63) without support from tool outputs, and declared the exchange “processed” despite truncated/insufficient tool confirmation. (5) The agent did not verify or confirm that the chosen replacement is indeed the cheapest earbud from the rest of the order, as the user requested. These collectively violate the requirements to confirm before writes, avoid unsupported claims, and ensure correct actions based on order status and details.
